declared_claims.text: Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate.
A well-appointed townhouse overlooking the square flies noble colors—a quiet contrast to the mud and clamor.
One figure in threadbare clothes stands uncannily still, gaze flicking to packs and faces more than the gate queue.
Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.
The notice board lists taxes, curfew rules, and a warning about a missing patrol.
A gate serjeant manages the crowd and keeps one eye on the roster board.
A tavern runner trades hot stew and rumors near the rain barrel.
Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line.
Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point.
